title: fab0 return: what an agent or tool step returns, schema 2
description: The base schema. A step's `return:` makes `questions` optional or required, and may give `data` a project schema.

data.description: Structured output, checked against the step's `return.schema`.

questions.description: What a person must answer before the unit can go on. Leaving it out, or an empty list, means none.
